Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.base
Package hibernate.base.persistence.tools

Class AbstractEntityModelLinter

java.lang.Object
hibernate.base.persistence.tools.AbstractEntityModelLinter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityModelLinter, PersistenceLinter
Direct Known Subclasses:
HibernateEntityModelLinter
public abstract class AbstractEntityModelLinter extends Object implements EntityModelLinter
Base template implementation of EntityModelLinter that executes namespace-agnostic Java reflection rules and delegates JPA-specific metamodel inspection to concrete Hibernate provider subclasses.

This abstract class performs common bytecode and reflection checks across all configured entity classes, including:

  • Validating that entity classes are not declared final (EntityLintRule.FINAL_ENTITY_CLASS).
  • Verifying the presence of a public or protected no-argument constructor (EntityLintRule.MISSING_NO_ARG_CONSTRUCTOR).
  • Ensuring persistent getter and setter methods are not declared final (EntityLintRule.FINAL_PERSISTENT_METHOD).

Concrete subclasses implement lintEntityModel(Class, List) to apply JPA annotation and Hibernate-specific metamodel inspections for their respective specification versions.

Since:
1.2.0
